title.zh: 卷三百九十一 列傳第一百五十 周必大 留正 胡晉臣
title.en: Volume 391 Biographies 150: Zhou Bida, Liu Zheng, Hu Jinchen
title.raw: 卷三百九十一 列傳第一百五十 周必大 留正 胡晉臣 Volume 391 Biographies 150: Zhou Bida, Liu Zheng, Hu Jinchen

sentences.zh: 周必大

translations.literal: Zhou Bida
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bida

sentences.zh: 周必大，字子充，一字洪道，其先鄭州管城人。

translations.literal: Zhou Bida, courtesy name Zichong, with an alternate name Hongdao; his ancestors were from Guancheng in Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bida, whose courtesy name was Zichong and who also used the name Hongdao, came from a family originally of Guancheng in Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖詵，宣和中倅廬陵，因家焉。

translations.literal: His grandfather Shen, during the Xuanhe reign served as vice-prefect of Luling, and thereby made his home there.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Shen served as vice-prefect of Luling during the Xuanhe period and settled the family there.

sentences.zh: 父利建，太學博士。

translations.literal: His father Lijian was a doctorate fellow of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lijian was a doctorate fellow at the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 必大少英特，父死，鞠於母家，母親督課之。

translations.literal: Bida in youth was outstanding; when his father died he was raised in his mother's family, and his mother personally supervised his lessons.
translations.idiomatic: From boyhood Bida showed marked talent. After his father's death he was raised in his mother's household, where she herself oversaw his studies.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十年，第進士，授徽州戶曹。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Shaoxing he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed revenue clerk of Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1150 he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed revenue clerk of Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 中博學宏詞科，教授建康府。

translations.literal: He passed the erudite learning and grand rhetoric examination and was made instructor of Jiankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the erudite learning and grand rhetoric examination and was appointed instructor at Jiankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 除太學錄，召試館職，高宗讀其策，曰：「掌制手也。

translations.literal: He was appointed recorder of the Imperial University and summoned to examination for a Hanlin post; Gaozong read his examination composition and said, "A hand for drafting imperial rescripts."
translations.idiomatic: He was made recorder of the Imperial University and summoned to the Hanlin examination. When Gaozong read his paper he said, "Here is a master of edicts."

sentences.zh: 」守祕書省正字。

translations.literal: " He was retained as rectifier of script in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: " He was retained as rectifier in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 館職復召試自此始。

translations.literal: From this time the re-summoning of Hanlin appointees to examination began.
translations.idiomatic: From this point the practice of re-examining Hanlin appointees by summons began.

sentences.zh: 兼國史院編修官，除監察御史。

translations.literal: He concurrently served as compiler of the National History Institute and was appointed investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: He also served as a compiler at the National History Institute and was appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 孝宗踐祚，除起居郎。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong ascended the throne, Bida was appointed attendant of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, Bida was appointed attendant of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 直前奏事，上曰：「朕舊見卿文，其以近作進。

translations.literal: He stepped forward to memorialize; the emperor said, "I have seen your writings before — submit your recent work."
translations.idiomatic: Stepping forward to address the throne, he was told by the emperor, "I have read your work before. Bring me your recent writings."

sentences.zh: 」上初御經筵，必大奏：「經筵非為分章析句，欲從容訪問，裨聖德，究治體。

translations.literal: " When the emperor first presided over the classics lecture, Bida memorialized: "The classics lecture is not for parsing chapters and sentences; it is meant for leisurely inquiry, to aid sagely virtue and investigate the substance of governance."
translations.idiomatic: " When the emperor first attended the classics lecture, Bida submitted: "The lecture is not meant for parsing chapters and clauses, but for unhurried inquiry — to nurture sagely virtue and probe the foundations of government."

sentences.zh: 」先是，左右史久不除，並記注壅積，必大請言動必書，兼修月進。

translations.literal: " Previously the left and right historiographers had long gone unfilled, and court records piled up; Bida requested that every word and act be recorded and that the monthly progress report also be compiled.
translations.idiomatic: " The left and right historiographers had long stood vacant and court records had piled up. Bida asked that every word and act be written down and that the monthly progress report be compiled as well.

sentences.zh: 乃命必大兼編類聖政所詳定官，又兼權中書舍人。

translations.literal: He was then ordered to serve concurrently as reviewer of the Institute for Compiling Sagely Governance and as acting drafting officer of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then named him concurrently reviewer at the Institute for Compiling Sagely Governance and acting drafting officer of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 侍經筵，嘗論邊事，上以蜀為憂，對曰：「蜀民久困，願詔撫諭，事定宜寬其賦。

translations.literal: Attending the classics lecture, he once discussed frontier affairs; the emperor was troubled about Shu, and Bida replied: "The people of Shu have long been distressed; I hope Your Majesty will issue edicts of reassurance, and when affairs are settled their taxes should be eased."
translations.idiomatic: While attending the lecture he once discussed frontier affairs. When the emperor expressed concern about Shu, Bida replied, "The people there have suffered for years. I hope Your Majesty will issue edicts of reassurance, and once affairs are settled their taxes should be lightened."

sentences.zh: 」應詔上十事，皆切時弊。

translations.literal: " In response to an imperial edict he submitted ten items, all striking at the abuses of the time.
translations.idiomatic: " In response to an imperial edict he submitted ten proposals, each addressing a pressing abuse of the day.

sentences.zh: 權給事中，繳駁不辟權幸。

translations.literal: As acting supervisory secretary, he returned memorials and would not yield to the powerful and favored.
translations.idiomatic: As acting supervisory secretary he returned improper memorials and refused to yield to powerful favorites.

sentences.zh: 翟婉容位官吏轉行礙止法，爭之力，上曰：「意卿止能文，不謂剛正如此。

translations.literal: When Lady Zhai Wanrong's relatives sought transfers in violation of the blocking statute, he contested it vigorously; the emperor said, "I thought you were only skilled at letters — I did not expect such firm uprightness."
translations.idiomatic: When relatives of Lady Zhai Wanrong sought transfers in violation of the blocking statute, he fought the matter vigorously. The emperor said, "I took you for a man of letters alone — I did not expect such firm integrity."

sentences.zh: 」金索講和時舊禮，必大條奏，請正敵國之名，金為之屈。

translations.literal: " When Jin demanded the old rites of the peace negotiations, Bida submitted a detailed memorial requesting correction of the enemy state's designation, and Jin yielded.
translations.idiomatic: " When the Jin pressed for the old peace-negotiation protocol, Bida submitted a detailed memorial calling for the proper designation of the enemy state, and the Jin side backed down.

sentences.zh: 曾覿、龍大淵得幸，臺諫交彈之，並遷知閤門事，必大與金安節不書黃，且奏曰：「陛下于政府侍從，欲罷則罷，欲貶則貶，獨於二人委曲遷就，恐人言紛紛未止也。

translations.literal: Zeng Di and Long Dayuan won favor; the censorate and remonstrance officials jointly impeached them, yet both were transferred to director of the Gatehouse; Bida and Jin Anjie refused to draft the yellow document, and memorialized: "Your Majesty, regarding ministers and attendants in government, dismisses whom you will and demotes whom you will — yet toward these two alone you make accommodating transfers; I fear public talk will not cease."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di and Long Dayuan had won the emperor's favor. Censors and remonstrators impeached them together, yet both were transferred to director of the Gatehouse. Bida and Jin Anjie refused to draft the appointment edict and memorialized, "Your Majesty dismisses or demotes ministers and attendants as you see fit, yet toward these two alone you make accommodating transfers. I fear the talk will never end."

sentences.zh: 」明日宣手詔，謂：「給舍為人鼓扇，太上時小事，安敢爾！

translations.literal: " The next day an imperial handwritten edict was proclaimed, saying: "The supervisory secretaries stir people up — trifling matters from the Retired Emperor's time, how dare they act thus!"
translations.idiomatic: " The next day the emperor proclaimed a handwritten edict: "The supervisory secretaries are stirring people up. These were trifles from the Retired Emperor's time — how dare they act like this!"

sentences.zh: 」必大入謝曰：「審爾，則是臣不以事太上者事陛下。

translations.literal: " Bida entered to apologize and said: "If that is so, then your servant has not served Your Majesty as he served the Retired Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: " Bida came in to apologize and said, "If that is truly the case, then I have not served Your Majesty with the same loyalty I showed the Retired Emperor."

sentences.zh: 」退待罪，上曰：「朕知卿舉職，但欲破朋黨、明紀綱耳。

translations.literal: " He withdrew to await punishment; the emperor said, "I know you performed your duty — I only wished to break up factions and clarify discipline."
translations.idiomatic: " He withdrew to await punishment. The emperor said, "I know you were doing your duty. I only wanted to break up factions and restore discipline."

sentences.zh: 」旬日，申前命，必大格不行，遂請祠去。

translations.literal: " Ten days later the previous appointments were reissued; Bida blocked them and would not execute them, then requested a temple post and left.
translations.idiomatic: " Ten days later the previous appointments were reissued. Bida blocked them and would not carry them out, then requested a temple post and left office.

sentences.zh: 久之，差知南劍州，改提點福建刑獄。

translations.literal: After a long while he was assigned to know Nanjian Prefecture, then transferred to judicial intendant of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was assigned prefect of Nanjian, then made judicial intendant of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 入對，願詔中外舉文武之才，區別所長為一籍，藏禁中，備緩急之用。

translations.literal: On audience he wished that an edict be issued for court and countryside to recommend men of civil and military talent, distinguishing their strengths in a single register kept in the inner palace for use in emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: At audience he asked that an edict summon talent civil and military from within and without the court, that their particular strengths be entered in a single register kept in the inner palace, and that it be held ready for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 除秘書少監、兼直學士院，兼領史職。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and concurrent academician of the Hanlin Academy, and also took charge of historiographical duties.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the Secretariat, concurrent Hanlin academician, and head of historiographical duties.

sentences.zh: 鄭聞草必大制，上改竄其末，引漢宣帝事。

translations.literal: Zheng Wen drafted Bida's composition; the emperor altered its ending and cited an episode of Han Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wen drafted a composition for Bida; the emperor revised its closing passage and cited an episode from the reign of Han Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 必大因奏曰：「陛下取漢宣帝之言，親制贊書，明示好惡。

translations.literal: Bida thereupon memorialized: "Your Majesty has taken the words of Han Emperor Xuan, personally composed the encomium, and clearly shown what you favor and disfavor."
translations.idiomatic: Bida then memorialized, "Your Majesty has taken the words of Han Emperor Xuan, personally composed the encomium, and made your preferences plain."

sentences.zh: 臣觀西漢所謂社稷臣，乃鄙朴之周勃，少文之汲黯，不學之霍光。

translations.literal: Your servant observes that the so-called pillars of state in Western Han were the rustic Zhou Bo, the minimally literate Ji An, and the unlearned Huo Guang.
translations.idiomatic: I observe that the so-called pillars of state in Western Han were the rustic Zhou Bo, the barely literate Ji An, and the unlettered Huo Guang.

sentences.zh: 至於公孫弘、蔡義、韋賢，號曰儒者，而持祿保位，故宣帝謂俗儒不達時宜。

translations.literal: As for Gongsun Hong, Cai Yi, and Wei Xian, styled Confucians, they clung to salary and preserved position — hence Xuan Di called vulgar Confucians unable to grasp the needs of the time.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Gongsun Hong, Cai Yi, and Wei Xian were styled Confucians yet clung to salary and office, which is why Emperor Xuan called vulgar Confucians incapable of grasping the needs of the age.

sentences.zh: 使宣帝知真儒，何至雜伯哉？

translations.literal: Had Xuan Di known true Confucians, how would he have resorted to mixing in Legalist methods?
translations.idiomatic: Had Emperor Xuan known true Confucians, how would he have fallen back on mixing in Legalist expedients?

sentences.zh: 願平心察之，不可有輕儒名。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will examine this with an even mind and not lightly slight the name of the Confucian.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will weigh this fairly and not lightly slight the name of the Confucian.

sentences.zh: 」上喜其精洽，欲與之日夕論文。

translations.literal: " The emperor was pleased with his thorough mastery and wished to discuss literature with him day and night.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was delighted with his thorough grasp of the matter and wished to discuss literature with him at length.

sentences.zh: 德壽加尊號，必大曰：「太上萬壽，而紹興末議文及近上表用『嗣皇帝』為未安。

translations.literal: When Degong received an honorific title, Bida said: "The Retired Emperor enjoys myriad years of life, yet in late Shaoxing discussion texts and recent memorials to the throne use 'Heir-Emperor' — this is unsettling."
translations.idiomatic: When the Retired Emperor at Degong Palace received an honorific title, Bida said, "The Retired Emperor enjoys long life, yet in late Shaoxing documents and recent memorials to the throne the term 'Heir-Emperor' is used, which is unsettling."

sentences.zh: 按建炎遙拜徽宗表，及唐憲宗上順宗尊號冊文，皆稱皇帝。

translations.literal: According to the Jianyan memorial of distant obeisance to Emperor Huizong, and the Tang Xianzong document presenting Shunzong's honorific title, all use 'Emperor.'
translations.idiomatic: The Jianyan memorial of distant obeisance to Emperor Huizong and the Tang document in which Emperor Xianzong presented Emperor Shunzong's honorific title both use the term 'Emperor.'

sentences.zh: 」議遂定。

translations.literal: " The discussion was thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was settled on that basis.

sentences.zh: 趙雄使金，齎國書，議受書禮。

translations.literal: Zhao Xiong was envoy to Jin, bearing the state letter; the protocol for receiving the letter was debated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiong went as envoy to the Jin, bearing the state letter, and the protocol for receiving it was debated.

sentences.zh: 必大立具草，略謂：「尊卑分定，或較等威；

translations.literal: Bida promptly prepared a draft, saying in summary: "Superior and inferior ranks are fixed — one may compare ceremonial dignity;"
translations.idiomatic: Bida promptly prepared a draft stating in essence, "Superior and inferior ranks are fixed, and ceremonial dignity may be compared,"

sentences.zh: 叔侄親情，豈嫌坐起！

translations.literal: "uncle and nephew share family feeling — why shrink from rising and sitting together!"
translations.idiomatic: "but uncle and nephew share family feeling — why should they scruple over rising and sitting together!"

sentences.zh: 」上褒之曰：「未嘗諭國書之意，而卿能道朕心中事，此大才也。」

translations.literal: " The emperor praised him, saying, "I never explained the intent of the state letter, yet you could speak what is in my heart — this is great talent."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor praised him: "I never explained the intent behind the state letter, yet you spoke what is in my heart. That is true talent."

sentences.zh: 兼權兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was concurrently acting vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was also made acting vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 奏請重侍從以儲將相，增臺諫以廣耳目，擇監司、郡守以補郎官。

translations.literal: He memorialized to strengthen attendant ministers as a reserve for generals and chancellors, increase censorate and remonstrance officials to broaden ears and eyes, and select circuit commissioners and prefects to fill palace posts.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to strengthen the attendant ministers as a reserve of future generals and chancellors, expand the censorate and remonstrance offices to widen the court's eyes and ears, and select circuit commissioners and prefects to fill palace posts.

sentences.zh: 尋權禮部侍郎、兼直學士院，同修國史、實錄院同修撰。

translations.literal: Soon he was acting vice minister of Rites and concurrent academician of the Hanlin Academy, and associate compiler of the National History and Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was acting vice minister of Rites, concurrent Hanlin academician, and associate compiler of the National History and Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 一日，詔同王之奇、陳良翰對選德殿，袖出手詔，舉唐太宗、魏徵問對，以在位久，功未有成，治效優劣，苦不自覺，命必大等極陳當否。

translations.literal: One day he was ordered together with Wang Zhiqi and Chen Lianghan to audience at the Hall of Selecting Virtue; the emperor drew out a handwritten edict citing the exchanges of Tang Taizong and Wei Zheng, saying that having been on the throne long yet achievement unaccomplished, he could not clearly perceive whether governance was superior or inferior, and ordered Bida and the others to state fully what was right or wrong.
translations.idiomatic: One day he was summoned with Wang Zhiqi and Chen Lianghan to audience at the Hall of Selecting Virtue. The emperor produced a handwritten edict citing the exchanges of Tang Taizong and Wei Zheng. Having reigned long without achieving his aims, he could not clearly judge whether his governance was sound, and he ordered Bida and the others to speak plainly what was right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 退而條陳：「陛下練兵以圖恢復而將數易，是用將之道未至；

translations.literal: Withdrawing, he submitted items in order: "Your Majesty drills troops to plan recovery yet changes generals repeatedly — the way of employing generals has not been attained;"
translations.idiomatic: On withdrawing he submitted a detailed memorial: "Your Majesty drills troops to plan recovery yet changes generals repeatedly — the art of employing commanders has not been mastered;"

sentences.zh: 擇人以守郡國而守數易，是責實之方未盡。

translations.literal: "you choose men to guard prefectures and yet change prefects repeatedly — the method of holding officials to real achievement is not complete."
translations.idiomatic: "you choose men to govern the prefectures yet change prefects repeatedly — the method of holding officials to real results is incomplete."

sentences.zh: 諸州長吏，倏來忽去，婺州四年易守者五，平江四年易守者四，甚至秀州一年而四易守，吏姦何由可察？

translations.literal: "Prefectural chiefs come and go abruptly — in Wuzhou five prefects in four years, in Pingjiang four in four years, and in Xiuzhou as many as four in one year; how can official malfeasance be detected?"
translations.idiomatic: "Prefects come and go in sudden succession: Wuzhou had five prefects in four years, Pingjiang four in four years, and Xiuzhou as many as four in a single year. How can official malfeasance be detected?"

sentences.zh: 民瘼何由可蘇？

translations.literal: How can the people's afflictions be relieved?"
translations.idiomatic: How can the people's suffering be relieved?"

sentences.zh: 」上善其言，為革二弊。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words and reformed the two abuses.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved his words and reformed both abuses.

sentences.zh: 江、湖旱，請捐南庫錢二十萬代民輸，上嘉之。

translations.literal: When the Jiang and Hu regions suffered drought, he requested donating two hundred thousand cash from the Southern Treasury to pay levies on the people's behalf; the emperor commended this.
translations.idiomatic: When drought struck the Jiang and Hu regions, he asked that two hundred thousand cash from the Southern Treasury be donated to pay levies on the people's behalf, and the emperor commended the proposal.

sentences.zh: 兼侍講，兼中書舍人。

translations.literal: He was concurrently lecturer-in-waiting and drafting officer of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was also made lecturer-in-waiting and drafting officer of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 未幾，辭直學士院，從之。

translations.literal: Before long he resigned the Hanlin Academy post, and the emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he resigned his Hanlin post, and the emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 張說再除簽書樞密院，給事中莫濟封還錄黃，必大奏曰：「昨舉朝以為不可，陛下亦自知其誤而止之矣。

translations.literal: Zhang Yue was again appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs; the supervisory secretary Mo Ji returned the yellow record; Bida memorialized: "Yesterday the whole court held this impossible, and Your Majesty yourself knew it was a mistake and stopped it."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue was again appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs. The supervisory secretary Mo Ji returned the appointment record. Bida memorialized, "Yesterday the whole court held this impossible, and Your Majesty yourself knew it was a mistake and stopped it."

sentences.zh: 曾未周歲，此命復出。

translations.literal: Not yet a full year has passed, and this appointment has reappeared.
translations.idiomatic: Less than a year has passed, and the appointment has reappeared.

sentences.zh: 貴戚預政，公私兩失，臣不敢具草。

translations.literal: Imperial kin interfering in government — public and private both lose; your servant dares not draft the document.
translations.idiomatic: When imperial kin interfere in government, both public and private interest suffer. I dare not draft the document.

sentences.zh: 」上批：「王嚴疾速撰入。

translations.literal: " The emperor annotated: "Wang Yan — draft it immediately."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor annotated, "Wang Yan — draft it at once."

sentences.zh: 濟、必大予宮觀，日下出國門。

translations.literal: " Mo Ji and Bida were given palace-temple posts and ordered to leave the capital gate that very day.
translations.idiomatic: " Mo Ji and Bida were given palace-temple posts and ordered out of the capital gate that same day.

sentences.zh: 」說露章薦濟、必大，於是濟除溫州，必大除建寧府。

translations.literal: " Yue submitted an open memorial recommending Mo Ji and Bida; thereupon Mo Ji was appointed to Wenzhou and Bida to Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " Yue submitted an open memorial recommending Mo Ji and Bida. Mo Ji was then appointed to Wenzhou and Bida to Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 濟被命即出，必大至豐城稱疾而歸，濟聞之大悔。

translations.literal: Mo Ji, on receiving the order, departed at once; Bida reached Fengcheng, pleaded illness, and returned home; when Mo Ji heard of this he deeply regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: Mo Ji left as soon as he received the order. Bida reached Fengcheng, pleaded illness, and returned home. When Mo Ji heard of this he was filled with regret.

sentences.zh: 必大三請祠，以此名益重。

translations.literal: Bida thrice requested a temple post, and by this his reputation grew heavier.
translations.idiomatic: Bida thrice requested a temple post, and his reputation grew all the greater for it.

sentences.zh: 久之，除敷文閣待制兼侍讀、兼權兵部侍郎、兼直學士院。

translations.literal: After a long while he was appointed attendant reader of the Fuwen Pavilion, concurrently acting vice minister of War and academician of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was appointed attendant reader of the Fuwen Pavilion, concurrently acting vice minister of War and Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 上勞之曰：「卿不迎合，無附麗，朕所倚重。

translations.literal: The emperor comforted him, saying, "You do not curry favor or attach yourself to others — you are one on whom I rely."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor comforted him, saying, "You do not curry favor or attach yourself to factions — you are a man I rely upon."

sentences.zh: 」除兵部侍郎，尋兼太子詹事。

translations.literal: " He was appointed vice minister of War, and soon also grand mentor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " He was appointed vice minister of War and soon also grand mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「太宗儲才為真宗、仁宗之用，仁宗儲才為治平、元祐之用。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Taizong stored talent for the use of Zhenzong and Renzong; Renzong stored talent for the use of the Zhiping and Yuanyou eras."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Taizong stored talent for the reigns of Zhenzong and Renzong; Renzong stored talent for the Zhiping and Yuanyou eras."

sentences.zh: 自章、蔡沮士氣，卒致裔夷之禍。

translations.literal: From the time Zhang and Cai depressed scholarly morale, it finally led to the calamity of barbarian invasion.
translations.idiomatic: Once Zhang and Cai depressed scholarly morale, the calamity of barbarian invasion followed in the end.

sentences.zh: 秦檜忌刻，逐人才，流弊至今。

translations.literal: Qin Hui was jealous and harsh, driving out talent; the harm flows down to today.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui was jealous and harsh and drove out talent; the harm still flows down to the present.

sentences.zh: 願陛下儲才于閒暇之日。」

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will store talent in days of leisure."
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will store up talent in days of leisure."

sentences.zh: 上日御毬場，必大曰：「固知陛下不忘閱武，然太祖二百年天下，屬在聖躬，願自愛。

translations.literal: The emperor daily attended the ball ground; Bida said: "I know well that Your Majesty does not forget military review, yet the two-hundred-year realm of Taizu rests on Your Sacred Person — I hope you will cherish yourself."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor attended the ball ground daily. Bida said, "I know Your Majesty has not forgotten military training, yet the two-hundred-year realm founded by Taizu rests on your person. I beg you to cherish yourself."

sentences.zh: 」上改容曰：「卿言甚忠，得非虞銜橛之變乎？

translations.literal: " The emperor changed expression and said, "Your words are very loyal — are you not fearing the incident of the horse biting the peg?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor's expression changed. He said, "Your words are deeply loyal. Are you not fearing the incident of the horse biting the peg?"

sentences.zh: 正以讐恥未雪，不欲自逸爾。

translations.literal: It is precisely because national humiliation is not yet washed away that I do not wish to indulge myself.
translations.idiomatic: It is precisely because national humiliation is not yet avenged that I do not wish to indulge myself.

sentences.zh: 」升兼侍讀，改吏部侍郎，除翰林學士。

translations.literal: " He was promoted to concurrent lecturer-in-waiting, transferred to vice minister of Personnel, and appointed Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: " He was promoted to concurrent lecturer-in-waiting, made vice minister of Personnel, and appointed Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 久雨，奏請減後宮給使，寬浙郡積逋，命省部議優恤。

translations.literal: After long rain he memorialized to reduce palace attendants in the rear apartments, ease accumulated arrears in Zhejiang prefectures, and order ministries to discuss preferential relief.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged rain he memorialized to reduce attendants in the inner palace, ease accumulated tax arrears in Zhejiang prefectures, and order the ministries to discuss preferential relief.

sentences.zh: 內直宣引，論：「金星近前星，武士擊毬，太子亦與，臣甚危之。

translations.literal: On inner duty he was summoned and stated: "The Metal Star draws near the Former Star; warriors strike the ball, and the heir apparent also joins — your servant is deeply alarmed."
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on inner duty, he said, "The Metal Star draws near the Former Star. Warriors are striking the ball and the heir apparent joins them as well. I am deeply alarmed."

sentences.zh: 」上俾語太子，必大曰：「太子，人子也，陛下命以驅馳，臣安敢勸以違命，陛下勿命之可也。」

translations.literal: " The emperor had him speak to the heir apparent; Bida said: "The heir apparent is a son; if Your Majesty orders him to gallop about, how dare your servant advise disobedience — it would be enough if Your Majesty did not order it."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor had him speak to the heir apparent. Bida said, "The heir apparent is a son. If Your Majesty orders him to gallop about, how can I advise disobedience? It would be enough if Your Majesty simply did not order it."

sentences.zh: 乞歸，弗許。

translations.literal: He requested to return home; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to retire home, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 上欲召人與之分職，因問：「呂祖謙能文否？

translations.literal: The emperor wished to summon someone to share duties with him and therefore asked, "Is Lü Zuqian skilled at letters?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to summon someone to share his duties and asked, "Is Lü Zuqian skilled at letters?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「祖謙涵養久，知典故，不但文字之工。

translations.literal: " He replied: "Zuqian has long cultivated himself and knows precedents — not merely skill in writing."
translations.idiomatic: " He replied, "Zuqian has long cultivated himself and knows precedent — not merely skill in writing."

sentences.zh: 」除禮部尚書兼翰林學士，進吏部兼承旨。

translations.literal: " He was appointed minister of Rites and concurrent Hanlin academician, then advanced to minister of Personnel and chief drafting officer.
translations.idiomatic: " He was appointed minister of Rites and concurrent Hanlin academician, then promoted minister of Personnel and chief drafting officer.

sentences.zh: 詔禮官議明堂典禮，必大定圜丘合宮互舉之議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered ritual officials to discuss the Bright Hall ceremonies; Bida settled the proposal for alternating performance of the suburban and Bright Hall rites.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered ritual officials to discuss Bright Hall ceremonies, and Bida settled the proposal for alternating the suburban and Bright Hall rites.

sentences.zh: 被旨撰《選德殿記》及《皇朝文鑒序》。

translations.literal: By imperial order he composed the "Record of the Hall of Selecting Virtue" and the preface to the Imperial Anthology of Song Literature.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order he wrote the Record of the Hall of Selecting Virtue and the preface to the Imperial Anthology of Song Literature.

sentences.zh: 必大在翰苑幾六年，制命溫雅，周盡事情，為一時詞臣之冠。

translations.literal: Bida was in the Hanlin Garden nearly six years; his edicts were warm and elegant, thorough in affairs, and he was the crown of literary ministers of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Bida served in the Hanlin nearly six years. His edicts were warm and elegant and thorough in substance, and he stood at the head of the literary ministers of his day.

sentences.zh: 或言其再入也，實曾覿所薦，而必大不知。

translations.literal: Some said that his re-entry was in fact recommended by Zeng Di, of which Bida was unaware.
translations.idiomatic: Some said his return to office was in fact due to Zeng Di's recommendation, though Bida himself did not know it.

sentences.zh: 除參知政事，上曰：「執政于宰相，固當和而不同。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice grand councilor; the emperor said, "Vice councilors toward the grand councilor should indeed be harmonious yet not identical."
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice grand councilor. The emperor said, "Vice councilors and the grand councilor should indeed be harmonious yet not identical."

sentences.zh: 前此宰相議事，執政更無語，何也？

translations.literal: Previously when the grand councilor discussed affairs, the vice councilors had nothing further to say — why?
translations.idiomatic: Previously when the grand councilor discussed affairs, the vice councilors had nothing further to say. Why was that?

sentences.zh: 」必大曰：「大臣自應互相可否。

translations.literal: " Bida said: "Great ministers ought naturally to approve or disapprove one another."
translations.idiomatic: " Bida said, "Great ministers ought naturally to approve or disapprove one another."

sentences.zh: 自秦檜當國，執政不敢措一辭，後遂以為當然。

translations.literal: From the time Qin Hui held the state, vice councilors dared not utter a word, and afterward this came to be regarded as natural.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Qin Hui dominated the state, vice councilors dared not speak, and afterward that came to be taken as natural.

sentences.zh: 陛下虛心無我，大臣乃欲自是乎？

translations.literal: Your Majesty is open-minded and without self-assertion — are great ministers still to insist on their own way?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is open-minded and without self-assertion — are great ministers still to insist on having their own way?

sentences.zh: 惟小事不敢有隱，則大事何由蔽欺。

translations.literal: Only if small matters are not concealed can great matters be shielded from deception.
translations.idiomatic: Only if small matters are not concealed can great matters be kept from deception.

sentences.zh: 」上深然之。

translations.literal: " The emperor deeply approved this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor deeply approved.

sentences.zh: 久旱，手詔求言。

translations.literal: After long drought, a handwritten edict sought opinions.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged drought the emperor issued a handwritten edict seeking opinions.

sentences.zh: 宰相謂此詔一下，州郡皆乞振濟，何以應之，約必大同奏。

translations.literal: The grand councilor said that once this edict was issued, every prefecture would beg relief — how could it be answered — and arranged for Bida to memorialize together.
translations.idiomatic: The grand councilor said that once the edict was issued every prefecture would beg relief and asked how the court could respond. He arranged for Bida to memorialize jointly with him.

sentences.zh: 必大曰：「上欲通下情，而吾儕阻隔之，何以塞公論？」

translations.literal: Bida said: "Your Majesty wishes to connect with sentiment below, yet we block it — how can public discussion be stifled?"
translations.idiomatic: Bida said, "Your Majesty wishes to hear sentiment from below, yet we would block it. How can public discussion be stifled?"

sentences.zh: 有介椒房之援求為郎者，上俾諭給舍繳駁，必大曰：「臺諫、給舍與三省相維持，豈可諭意？

translations.literal: Someone with connections through the inner palace sought a palace post; the emperor had Bida instruct the supervisory secretaries to return the document; Bida said: "The censorate and supervisory secretaries check the Three Departments — how can intent be conveyed to them?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone with connections through the inner palace sought a palace post. The emperor had Bida instruct the supervisory secretaries to return the appointment. Bida said, "The censorate and supervisory secretaries exist to check the Three Departments. How can we convey intent to them in advance?"

sentences.zh: 不從失體，從則壞法。

translations.literal: If they do not comply, propriety is lost; if they comply, the law is broken.
translations.idiomatic: If they refuse, propriety is lost; if they comply, the law is broken.

sentences.zh: 命下之日，臣等自當執奏。

translations.literal: On the day the order is issued, your servants will themselves memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: When the order is issued, we ourselves will memorialize.

sentences.zh: 」上喜曰：「肯如此任怨耶？

translations.literal: " The emperor was pleased and said, "You are willing to bear such resentment?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was pleased and said, "You are willing to bear such resentment?"

sentences.zh: 」必大曰：「當予而不予則有怨，不當予而不予，何怨之有。

translations.literal: " Bida said: "If one should grant and does not, there is resentment; if one should not grant and does not, what resentment is there?"
translations.idiomatic: " Bida said, "If one should grant and does not, there will be resentment. If one should not grant and does not, what resentment can there be?"

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「此任責，非任怨也。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "This is shouldering responsibility, not courting resentment."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "This is shouldering responsibility, not courting resentment."

sentences.zh: 」除知樞密院。

translations.literal: " He was appointed to know the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " He was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「每見宰相不能處之事，卿以數語決之，三省本未可輟卿也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Whenever I see affairs the grand councilor cannot settle, you resolve them in a few words — the Three Departments could not really spare you."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Whenever the grand councilor cannot settle a matter, you resolve it in a few words. The Three Departments could not really have spared you."

sentences.zh: 山陽舊屯軍八千，雷世方乞止差鎮江一軍五千，必大曰：「山陽控扼清河口，若今減而後增，必致敵疑。

translations.literal: At Shanyang eight thousand troops were formerly garrisoned; Lei Shifang requested stopping the dispatch of five thousand from one Jiang army; Bida said: "Shanyang controls the Qinghe mouth — if we reduce now and increase later, we will surely arouse enemy suspicion."
translations.idiomatic: Eight thousand troops were formerly garrisoned at Shanyang. Lei Shifang asked to stop dispatching five thousand from a Jiang army. Bida said, "Shanyang controls the mouth of the Qing River. If we reduce now and increase later, we will surely arouse enemy suspicion."

sentences.zh: 揚州武鋒軍本屯山陽者，不若歲撥三千，與鎮江五千同戍。

translations.literal: The Wufeng Army of Yangzhou originally garrisoned at Shanyang — better to allocate three thousand yearly to garrison together with Jiang's five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The Wufeng Army of Yangzhou, originally garrisoned at Shanyang, had better be allocated three thousand men yearly to serve together with Jiang's five thousand.

sentences.zh: 」郭杲請移荊南軍萬二千永屯襄陽，必大言：「襄陽固要地，江陵亦江北喉襟。

translations.literal: " Guo Gao requested moving twelve thousand Jingnan troops to garrison Xiangyang permanently; Bida said: "Xiangyang is indeed a vital place, but Jiangling is also the throat of the north of the Yangtze."
translations.idiomatic: " Guo Gao asked to move twelve thousand Jingnan troops to garrison Xiangyang permanently. Bida said, "Xiangyang is indeed vital, but Jiangling is also the strategic throat north of the Yangtze."

sentences.zh: 」於是留二千人。

translations.literal: " Thereupon two thousand were left behind.
translations.idiomatic: " Two thousand men were therefore left behind.

sentences.zh: 上諭以「金既還上京，且分諸子出鎮，將若何？

translations.literal: The emperor instructed him: "Jin has returned to the Upper Capital and is dividing its sons to hold fiefs — what is to be done?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked him, "The Jin have returned to the Upper Capital and are sending their sons out to hold fiefs. What should we do?"

sentences.zh: 」必大言：「敵恫疑虛喝，正恐我先動。

translations.literal: " Bida said: "The enemy intimidates and bluffs — they fear precisely that we will move first."
translations.idiomatic: " Bida said, "The enemy is intimidating and bluffing. They fear precisely that we will move first."

sentences.zh: 當鎮之以靜，惟邊將不可不精擇。」

translations.literal: We should calm them by remaining steady; only frontier commanders must be chosen with utmost care."
translations.idiomatic: We should calm them by holding steady. Only frontier commanders must be chosen with the utmost care."

sentences.zh: 拜樞密使。

translations.literal: He was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「若有邊事，宣撫使惟卿可，他人不能也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If there are frontier affairs, only you can serve as pacification commissioner — others cannot."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "If frontier trouble arises, only you can serve as pacification commissioner. No one else can."

sentences.zh: 」上諸軍升差籍，時點召一二察能否，主帥悚激，無敢容私。

translations.literal: " He submitted the promotion registers of all armies, from time to time summoning one or two to inspect ability; commanders were awed and stirred, daring not harbor private interests.
translations.idiomatic: " He submitted promotion registers for all armies and from time to time summoned one or two men to test their ability. Commanders were awed into diligence and dared not harbor private interests.

sentences.zh: 創諸軍點試法，其在外解發而親閱之。

translations.literal: He created the method of spot-testing all armies; those dispatched from outside he personally reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: He created a system of spot-testing all armies and personally reviewed those dispatched from outside.

sentences.zh: 池州李忠孝自言正將二人不能開弓，乞罷軍。

translations.literal: Li Zhongxiao of Chizhou reported that two company commanders could not draw the bow and begged to disband the army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongxiao of Chizhou reported that two company commanders could not draw the bow and asked to disband the unit.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此樞使措置之效也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This is the effect of the military commissioner's arrangements."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "This is the effect of the military commissioner's arrangements."

sentences.zh: 」金州謀帥，必大曰：「與其私舉，不若明揚。

translations.literal: " When Jin Prefecture sought a commander, Bida said: "Rather than private recommendation, better open nomination."
translations.idiomatic: " When Jin Prefecture needed a commander, Bida said, "Rather than private recommendation, it is better to nominate openly."

sentences.zh: 」令侍從、管軍薦舉。

translations.literal: " He ordered attendant ministers and army supervisors to recommend candidates.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered attendant ministers and army supervisors to recommend candidates.

sentences.zh: 或傳大石林牙將加兵于金，忽魯大王分據上京，邊臣結約夏國。

translations.literal: Some reported that the Jin prince Shilin would increase troops, that Prince Hulü was seizing the Upper Capital, and that frontier officials were allying with Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors spread that the Jin prince Shilin would increase troops, that Prince Hulü was seizing the Upper Capital, and that frontier officials were allying with Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 必大皆屏不省，勸上持重，勿輕動。

translations.literal: Bida set all aside unread and urged the emperor to hold steady and not act lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Bida set all such reports aside unread and urged the emperor to hold steady and not act rashly.

sentences.zh: 既而所傳果妄。

translations.literal: Afterward what was reported proved false.
translations.idiomatic: In time the reports proved false.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「 卿真有先見之明。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "You truly had foresight."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You truly had foresight."

sentences.zh: 淳熙十四年二月，拜右丞相。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourteenth year of Chunxi he was appointed right grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1187 he was appointed right grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 首奏：「今內外晏然，殆將二紀，此正可懼之時，當思經遠之計，不可紛更欲速。

translations.literal: His first memorial: "Now within and without are tranquil, nearly two reign-periods — this is precisely a time to be feared; one should think of long-range plans and not change things hastily in pursuit of speed."
translations.idiomatic: In his first memorial he said, "Within and without the realm are tranquil, and nearly two reign-periods have passed. This is precisely a time for alarm. We should think in terms of long-range plans and not change things hastily in pursuit of speed."

sentences.zh: 」秀州乞減大軍總制錢二萬，吏請勘當，必大曰：「此豈勘當時耶？

translations.literal: " Xiuzhou requested reducing twenty thousand in general-command funds for the great army; clerks asked for investigation; Bida said: "Is this a time for investigation?"
translations.idiomatic: " Xiuzhou asked to reduce twenty thousand in general-command funds for the great army. Clerks asked for an investigation. Bida said, "Is this a time for investigation?"

sentences.zh: 」立蠲之。

translations.literal: " He immediately exempted it.
translations.idiomatic: " He immediately granted the exemption.

sentences.zh: 封事多言大臣同異，必大曰：「各盡所見，歸於一是，豈可尚同？

translations.literal: Sealed memorials often spoke of agreement and disagreement among great ministers; Bida said: "Each states his view and returns to unity — how can one value mere sameness?"
translations.idiomatic: Sealed memorials often spoke of agreement and disagreement among great ministers. Bida said, "Each states his view and they return to unity. How can one value mere sameness?"

sentences.zh: 陛下復祖宗舊制，命三省覆奏而後行，正欲上下相維，非止奉行文書也。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty has restored the old system of the ancestors, ordering the Three Departments to report back before execution — this is precisely to make above and below check one another, not merely to carry out documents."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has restored the ancestral system, ordering the Three Departments to report back before execution. That is precisely to make above and below check one another, not merely to carry out documents."

sentences.zh: 高宗升遐，議用顯仁例，遣三使詣金。

translations.literal: When Gaozong passed away, it was proposed to follow the Xianren precedent and send three envoys to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong passed away, the court proposed following the Xianren precedent and sending three envoys to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 必大謂：「今昔事殊，不當畏敵曲徇。

translations.literal: Bida said: "Present and past affairs differ — one should not fear the enemy and bend to them."
translations.idiomatic: Bida said, "Present and past affairs differ. We should not fear the enemy and bend to them."

sentences.zh: 」止之。

translations.literal: " He stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: " He stopped the proposal.

sentences.zh: 賀正使至，或請權易淡黃袍御殿受書，必大執不可，遂為縞素服，就帷幄引見。

translations.literal: When the New Year's envoy arrived, some requested temporarily changing to the pale yellow robe to receive the letter in the main hall; Bida insisted this could not be done; they therefore wore unbleached mourning dress and received him at the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: When the New Year's envoy arrived, some asked to change temporarily to the pale yellow robe to receive the letter in the main hall. Bida insisted this could not be done. They therefore wore unbleached mourning dress and received him at the curtain.

sentences.zh: 十五年，思陵發引，援熙陵呂端故事，請行，乃攝太傅，為山陵使。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, when Siling's coffin was moved, citing Lü Duan's precedent at Xiling, he requested to go; he was then acting grand mentor and made mountain-tomb commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, when Gaozong's coffin was moved, citing Lü Duan's precedent at Xiling, he asked to go along and was made acting grand mentor and mountain-tomb commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明堂加恩，封濟國公。

translations.literal: At the Bright Hall grace was extended; he was enfeoffed Duke of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: At the Bright Hall ceremony he received extended grace and was enfeoffed Duke of Ji.

sentences.zh: 十一月，留身乞去，上獎勞再三。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he remained behind to beg leave; the emperor commended and comforted him again and again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he remained behind to request retirement. The emperor commended and comforted him repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 忽宣諭：「比年病倦，欲傳位太子，須卿且留。

translations.literal: Suddenly an edict was proclaimed: "In recent years I have been ill and weary and wish to pass the throne to the heir apparent — I need you to remain for now."
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly an edict was proclaimed: "In recent years I have been ill and weary and wish to pass the throne to the heir apparent. I need you to remain for now."

sentences.zh: 」必大言：「聖體康寧，止因孝思稍過，何遽至倦勤。

translations.literal: " Bida said: "Your Sacred Person is healthy and at ease — it is only that filial thought has gone slightly too far; how could you hastily reach weariness in rule?"
translations.idiomatic: " Bida said, "Your Sacred Person is healthy and at ease. It is only that filial feeling has gone slightly too far. How could you hastily speak of weariness in rule?"

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「禮莫大於事宗廟，而孟饗多以病分詣；

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "No rite is greater than serving the ancestral temple, yet at the first-month offering I often send others because of illness;"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "No rite is greater than serving the ancestral temple, yet at the first-month offering I often send substitutes because of illness;"

sentences.zh: 孝莫重於執喪，而不得自至德壽宮。

translations.literal: no filial piety is weightier than observing mourning, yet I cannot myself go to Degong Palace.
translations.idiomatic: no filial piety is weightier than observing mourning, yet I cannot go in person to Degong Palace.

sentences.zh: 欲不退休，得乎？

translations.literal: If I do not wish to retire, is that possible?
translations.idiomatic: If I do not retire, how can that be?

sentences.zh: 朕方以此委卿。

translations.literal: I am just now entrusting this to you.
translations.idiomatic: I am entrusting this to you now.

sentences.zh: 」必大泣而退。

translations.literal: " Bida wept and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " Bida wept and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，密賜紹興傳位親劄。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the twelfth month he was secretly given Gaozong's personal note on the abdication.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the twelfth month he was secretly given Gaozong's personal note on the abdication.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命留身議定。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day he was ordered to remain and settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day he was ordered to remain and settle the matter.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，又命預草詔，專以奉几筵、侍東朝為意。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the second month he was again ordered to draft the edict in advance, with intent focused on attending the spirit tablet and serving the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the second month he was again ordered to draft the edict in advance, with intent focused on attending the spirit tablet and serving the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 拜左丞相、許國公。

translations.literal: He was appointed left grand councilor and Duke of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed left grand councilor and Duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 參政留正拜右丞相。

translations.literal: Vice councilor Liu Zheng was appointed right grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Vice councilor Liu Zheng was appointed right grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上始以內禪意諭二府。

translations.literal: On the renzi day the emperor first informed the two councils of his intent to abdicate internally.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the emperor first informed the two councils of his intent to abdicate.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉朔，降傳位詔。

translations.literal: On the first xinyou day of the second month the abdication edict was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month the abdication edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 翼日，上吉服御紫宸殿。

translations.literal: The next day the emperor in auspicious dress attended the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the emperor in auspicious dress attended the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 必大奏：「陛下巽位與子，盛典再見，度越千古。

translations.literal: Bida memorialized: "Your Majesty has yielded the position to your son — this great ceremony appears again and surpasses a thousand ages."
translations.idiomatic: Bida memorialized, "Your Majesty has yielded the throne to your son. This great ceremony appears again and surpasses anything in a thousand ages."

sentences.zh: 顧自今不得日侍天顏。

translations.literal: Yet from now on I cannot daily attend Your countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from now on I cannot attend Your countenance day by day.

sentences.zh: 」因哽噎不能言，上亦泫然曰：「正賴卿等協贊新君。」

translations.literal: " He choked and could not speak; the emperor also with tears said: "I am just relying on you to assist and support the new ruler."
translations.idiomatic: " He choked and could not continue. The emperor too was in tears and said, "I am relying on you to assist and support the new ruler."

sentences.zh: 光宗問當世急務，奏用人、求言二事。

translations.literal: Guangzong asked the urgent affairs of the age; he memorialized on two matters: employing men and seeking counsel.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong asked the urgent affairs of the age, he memorialized on two matters: employing men and seeking counsel.

sentences.zh: 三月，拜少保、益國公。

translations.literal: In the third month he was appointed junior guardian and Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was appointed junior guardian and Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 李巘草二相制，抑揚不同，上召巘令帖麻改定，既而斥巘予郡。

translations.literal: Li Yan drafted the appointments of the two councilors with unequal praise and blame; the emperor summoned Yan and ordered the edict pasted and revised, then afterward dismissed Yan to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yan drafted the appointments of the two councilors with unequal praise and blame. The emperor summoned Yan, ordered the edict revised, and then dismissed him to a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 必大求去。

translations.literal: Bida requested to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Bida asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 何澹為司業，久不遷，留正奏選之。

translations.literal: He Dan was vice director of studies and long without promotion; Liu Zheng memorialized to select him.
translations.idiomatic: He Dan was vice director of studies and long without promotion. Liu Zheng memorialized to have him selected.

sentences.zh: 澹憾必大而德正，至是為諫長，遂首劾必大。

translations.literal: Dan resented Bida and favored Zheng; reaching this post as chief remonstrator, he was first to impeach Bida.
translations.idiomatic: Dan resented Bida and favored Liu Zheng. Now chief remonstrator, he was the first to impeach Bida.

sentences.zh: 詔以觀文殿大學士判潭州。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him grand academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and assigned him to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him grand academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and assigned him to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 澹論不已，遂以少保充醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: Dan's attacks did not cease; he was then made junior guardian and commissioner of the Liquan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Dan's attacks did not cease. Bida was then made junior guardian and commissioner of the Liquan Temple.

sentences.zh: 判隆興府，不赴，復除觀文殿學士、判潭州，復大觀。

translations.literal: Assigned to Longxing Prefecture, he did not go; again appointed academician of the Observing Culture Hall and assigned to Tanzhou, then restored to grand academician.
translations.idiomatic: Assigned to Longxing Prefecture, he did not go. He was again appointed academician of the Observing Culture Hall and assigned to Tanzhou, then restored to grand academician.

sentences.zh: 又坐所舉官以賄敗，降滎陽郡公。

translations.literal: Again, because an official he had recommended was ruined by bribery, he was demoted to Duke of Xingyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Again, because an official he had recommended was ruined by bribery, he was demoted to Duke of Xingyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 復益國公，改判隆興，辭，除醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: Restored as Duke of Yi, transferred to Longxing, declined, and was appointed commissioner of the Liquan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Restored as Duke of Yi, transferred to Longxing, he declined and was appointed commissioner of the Liquan Temple.

sentences.zh: 寧宗即位，求直言，奏四事：曰聖孝，曰敬天，曰崇儉，曰久任。

translations.literal: When Ningzong ascended the throne and sought frank speech, he memorialized four matters: sagely filial piety, reverence for Heaven, esteem for frugality, and long tenure in office.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningzong ascended the throne and sought frank speech, he memorialized on four matters: sagely filial piety, reverence for Heaven, esteem for frugality, and long tenure in office.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年，三上表引年，遂以少傅致仕。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingyuan he thrice submitted memorials citing age and then retired as junior mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1195 he thrice submitted memorials citing age and then retired as junior mentor.

sentences.zh: 二年，復少傅。

translations.literal: In the second year he was again made junior mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was again made junior mentor.

sentences.zh: 四年，薨，年七十有九。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died, aged seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died at the age of seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 贈太師，諡「文忠」。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made grand preceptor and given the posthumous title "Cultured and Loyal."
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand preceptor and given the posthumous title Cultured and Loyal.

sentences.zh: 寧宗題篆其墓碑曰「忠文耆德之碑」。

translations.literal: Ningzong inscribed his tombstone in seal script: "Stele of Loyal Culture and Venerable Virtue."
translations.idiomatic: Ningzong inscribed his tombstone in seal script: Stele of Loyal Culture and Venerable Virtue.

sentences.zh: 自號「平園老叟」，著書八十一種，有《平園集》二百卷。

translations.literal: He styled himself "Old Man of the Level Garden," wrote eighty-one works, and had the Collected Works of the Level Garden in two hundred juan.
translations.idiomatic: He styled himself Old Man of the Level Garden, wrote eighty-one works, and left the Collected Works of the Level Garden in two hundred juan.

sentences.zh: 嘗建「三忠堂」於鄉，謂歐陽文忠修、楊忠襄邦乂、胡忠簡銓皆廬陵人，必大平生所敬慕，為文記之，蓋絕筆也。

translations.literal: He once built the "Hall of Three Loyalties" in his home district, saying Ouyang Xiu the Cultured and Loyal, Yang Bangyi the Loyal and Commendable, and Hu Quan the Loyal and Simple were all men of Luling whom Bida had admired all his life; he wrote an essay to record it — likely his final composition.
translations.idiomatic: He once built the Hall of Three Loyalties in his home district for Ouyang Xiu, Yang Bangyi, and Hu Quan — all men of Luling whom Bida had admired all his life. The essay he wrote to record it was likely his final composition.

sentences.zh: 一子：綸。

translations.literal: One son: Lun.
translations.idiomatic: He had one son: Lun.

sentences.zh: 留正，字仲至，泉州永春人。

translations.literal: Liu Zheng, courtesy name Zhongzhi, was a man of Yongchun in Quan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng, whose courtesy name was Zhongzhi, was a native of Yongchun in Quan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六世祖從效，事太祖，為清遠軍節度使，封鄂國公。

translations.literal: His sixth-generation ancestor Congxiao served Taizu, was military commissioner of Qingyuan Army, and was enfeoffed Duke of E.
translations.idiomatic: His sixth-generation ancestor Congxiao served Emperor Taizu, was military commissioner of Qingyuan Army, and was enfeoffed Duke of E.

sentences.zh: 紹興十三年，第進士，授南恩州陽江尉、清海軍節度判官。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Shaoxing he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Yangjiang in Nan'en Prefecture and military judge of Qinghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: In 1143 he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Yangjiang in Nan'en Prefecture and military judge of Qinghai Army.

sentences.zh: 龔茂良守番禺，正言：「在法：劫盜贓滿五貫死，海盜加等。

translations.literal: When Gong Maoliang was prefect of Panyu, Zheng said: "By law, robbery with booty of five strings means death; pirates receive an added grade."
translations.idiomatic: When Gong Maoliang was prefect of Panyu, Zheng said, "By law, robbery with booty of five strings means death, and pirates receive an added grade."

sentences.zh: 小民餌利，率身陷重辟。

translations.literal: Common people tempted by profit mostly fall into heavy punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Common people tempted by profit mostly fall into capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 請鏤梓海上，使戶知之。

translations.literal: I request carving blocks and publishing at sea so every household may know.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that blocks be carved and the law published along the coast so every household may know it.

sentences.zh: 」民始知避。

translations.literal: " The people then began to avoid violation.
translations.idiomatic: " The people then began to avoid violation.

sentences.zh: 用茂良薦，赴都堂審察。

translations.literal: On Maoliang's recommendation he went to capital review at the chief council.
translations.idiomatic: On Maoliang's recommendation he went to the capital for review at the chief council.

sentences.zh: 宰相虞允文奇之，薦於上。

translations.literal: Grand councilor Yu Yunwen considered him extraordinary and recommended him to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councilor Yu Yunwen considered him extraordinary and recommended him to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 得對，正言：「國家右文而略武備，祖宗以天下全力用於西夏，承平日久，邊不為備，至敵人長驅而不能支。

translations.literal: Granted audience, Zheng said: "The state esteems civil affairs and neglects military preparedness; the ancestors applied the realm's full strength against Western Xia; long peace made the frontier unprepared, until the enemy drove deep and we could not hold."
translations.idiomatic: At audience Zheng said, "The state esteems civil affairs and neglects military preparedness. The ancestors applied the realm's full strength against Western Xia. Long peace left the frontier unprepared until the enemy drove deep and we could not hold."

sentences.zh: 今當改轍，使文武並用。

translations.literal: Now we should change course and employ civil and military together.
translations.idiomatic: Now we should change course and employ civil and military talent together.

sentences.zh: 」孝宗嘉歎，書劄中要語下三省施行。

translations.literal: " Xiaozong praised and sighed, wrote out the key phrases in a note, and sent them to the Three Departments for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiaozong praised him warmly, wrote out the key phrases in a note, and sent them to the Three Departments for implementation.

sentences.zh: 知循州，陛辭，言：「士大夫名節不立，國家緩急無所倚仗。

translations.literal: Knowing Xun Prefecture, on farewell audience he said: "If scholar-officials do not establish reputation and integrity, the state in urgency has nothing to rely on."
translations.idiomatic: When appointed prefect of Xun, on farewell audience he said, "If scholar-officials do not establish reputation and integrity, the state will have nothing to rely on in an emergency."

sentences.zh: 靖康金人犯闕，死義者少，因亂謀利者多。

translations.literal: At Jingkang when the Jin violated the capital, few died for righteousness; many sought profit amid disorder.
translations.idiomatic: At Jingkang, when the Jin violated the capital, few died for righteousness, while many sought profit amid the disorder.

sentences.zh: 今欲恢復，當崇尚名節。

translations.literal: Now wishing recovery, we should exalt reputation and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: If we wish recovery now, we should exalt reputation and integrity.

sentences.zh: 」上益喜，明日諭輔臣：「留正奏事，議論耿耿，可與職事官。

translations.literal: " The emperor was still more pleased; the next day he told the chief ministers: "Liu Zheng memorializes with bright, firm discourse — he may be given a substantive post."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was still more pleased. The next day he told the chief ministers, "Liu Zheng memorializes with bright, firm discourse. He may be given a substantive post."

sentences.zh: 」除軍器監簿，歷官考功郎官。

translations.literal: " He was appointed registrar of the Armory Directorate and served through the post of reviewer in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: " He was appointed registrar of the Armory Directorate and later served as reviewer in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 太常諡葉義問「恭簡」，正覆諡，言：「義問將兵出疆，不知敵人情偽，及金犯邊，督視寡謀，幾至敗事。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Ritual gave Ye Yiwen the posthumous title "Respectful and Simple"; Zheng reviewed the title and said: "Yiwen led troops beyond the border without knowing the enemy's truth or falsehood; when Jin violated the frontier he supervised with little strategy and nearly brought defeat."
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Ritual gave Ye Yiwen the posthumous title Respectful and Simple. Zheng reviewed the title and said, "Yiwen led troops beyond the border without knowing the enemy's situation. When the Jin violated the frontier he supervised with little strategy and nearly brought defeat."

sentences.zh: 」下太常更議，時論韙之。

translations.literal: " The matter was sent down to the Directorate of Ritual for reconsideration; opinion of the time approved him.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was sent to the Directorate of Ritual for reconsideration, and opinion of the time approved him.

sentences.zh: 擢起居舍人，尋權中書舍人。

translations.literal: He was promoted attendant of the heir apparent and soon made acting drafting officer of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted attendant of the heir apparent and soon made acting drafting officer of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 光宗自東宮朝，顧見正，謂左右曰：「修整如此，其人可知。

translations.literal: When Guangzong attended court from the Eastern Palace, he looked and saw Zheng, and said to those beside him: "So well ordered in appearance — the man can be known."
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong attended court from the Eastern Palace, he saw Zheng and said to those beside him, "So well ordered in appearance — the man can be known at once."

sentences.zh: 」乃請於上，兼太子左諭德。

translations.literal: " He then requested of the emperor that Zheng also serve as left mentor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " He then asked the emperor to appoint Zheng also left mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 正言：「記注進御，非設官本意。

translations.literal: Zheng said: "Submitting the record notes to the throne was not the original intent of the office."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng said, "Submitting the record notes to the throne was not the original intent of the office."

sentences.zh: 乞自今免奏御。

translations.literal: I beg that from now on this be exempted from presentation to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that from now on they be exempted from presentation to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: " An edict assented.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict assented.

sentences.zh: 為中書舍人兼侍講，兼權兵部侍郎，除給事中。

translations.literal: He served as drafting officer of the Secretariat and lecturer-in-waiting, concurrently acting vice minister of War, and was appointed supervisory secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He served as drafting officer of the Secretariat and lecturer-in-waiting, concurrently acting vice minister of War, and was appointed supervisory secretary.

sentences.zh: 張說子薦往視鎮江戰艦，挾勢遊觀，沉舟溺卒，除知閤門事、樞密副承旨，正封還詞頭。

translations.literal: Zhang Yue's son Jian went to inspect Jiang war vessels, used his power to tour and sightsee, a boat sank and soldiers drowned; he was appointed director of the Gatehouse and deputy recipient at the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zheng sealed and returned the appointment draft.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue's son Jian went to inspect war vessels at Jiang, used his power to tour and sightsee, and a boat sank drowning soldiers. He was appointed director of the Gatehouse and deputy recipient at the Bureau of Military Affairs. Zheng sealed and returned the appointment draft.

sentences.zh: 洪邦直除御史，正言：「邦直為邑人所訟，不宜任風憲。」

translations.literal: Hong Bangzhi was appointed censor. Zheng said: "Bangzhi has been sued by people of his county; he is unsuitable to hold the office of censorial oversight."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Bangzhi was appointed censor. Zheng said, "Bangzhi has been sued by people of his county and is unsuitable to hold the office of censorial oversight."

sentences.zh: 兼權吏部尚書，言：「用人莫先論相。

translations.literal: Concurrently acting Minister of Personnel, he said: "In employing men, nothing comes before judging the chancellor."
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently acting Minister of Personnel, he said, "In appointing men, nothing comes before judging the chancellor."

sentences.zh: 陛下志在恢復，而相位不能任輔贊。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's will is set on recovery, yet the post of chancellor cannot bear the burden of assisting and supporting.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's will is set on recovery, yet the post of chancellor cannot bear the burden of assisting and supporting you.

sentences.zh: 望精選人才，與圖大計。

translations.literal: I hope you will carefully select men of talent and join in plotting the great design.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will carefully select men of talent and join in planning the great design.

sentences.zh: 」時相益不樂，以顯謨閣直學士出知紹興府。

translations.literal: " The chief minister was all the more displeased, and Zheng was dispatched as academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and made prefect of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: " The chief minister was all the more displeased, and Zheng was dispatched as academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and made prefect of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 侍御史范仲芑劾前帥贓六十萬，有詔覈責。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Fan Zhongqi impeached the former prefect for six hundred thousand in graft; an edict ordered verification and censure.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Fan Zhongqi impeached the former prefect for six hundred thousand in graft; an edict ordered verification and censure.

sentences.zh: 正明其非辜，御史怒，並劾正，降顯謨閣待制、提舉玉隆萬壽宮。

translations.literal: Zheng showed that the former prefect was not guilty. The censor was angry and also impeached Zheng, who was demoted to gentleman awaiting orders of the Hall for Promoting Governance and made director of the Yulong Everlasting Longevity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng showed that the former prefect was not guilty. The censor grew angry and also impeached Zheng, who was demoted to gentleman awaiting orders of the Hall for Promoting Governance and made director of the Yulong Everlasting Longevity Palace.

sentences.zh: 尋復職。

translations.literal: Soon his former rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 知贛州，奏減上供米，不報。

translations.literal: As prefect of Ganzhou he memorialized to reduce the grain sent up as tribute; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Ganzhou he memorialized to reduce the grain sent up as tribute, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 及為相，蠲一萬八千石。

translations.literal: When he became chancellor he remitted eighteen thousand bushels.
translations.idiomatic: When he became chancellor he remitted eighteen thousand bushels.

sentences.zh: 知隆興府。

translations.literal: He was made prefect of Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was made prefect of Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進龍圖閣直學士、四川制置使，兼知成都府。

translations.literal: He was promoted to academician on duty at the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, Sichuan commissioner for military affairs, and concurrently prefect of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to academician on duty at the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, Sichuan commissioner for military affairs, and concurrently prefect of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 平西蜀折租價，歲減酒課三十八萬。

translations.literal: He standardized Western Shu's reduced-rent prices and cut the annual wine tax by three hundred eighty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He standardized Western Shu's reduced-rent prices and cut the annual wine tax by three hundred eighty thousand.

sentences.zh: 乾道初，羌酋奴兒結越大渡河，據安靜砦，侵漢地幾百里。

translations.literal: In the early Qiandao period, the Qiang chieftain Nu Erjie crossed the Dadu River, seized Anjing Fort, and encroached on Han territory for nearly a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qiandao period, the Qiang chieftain Nu Erjie crossed the Dadu River, seized Anjing Fort, and encroached on Han territory for nearly a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 正密授諸將方略，擒奴兒結以歸，盡俘其黨，羌平。

translations.literal: Zheng secretly entrusted the generals with his strategy; Nu Erjie was captured and brought back, all his followers were taken prisoner, and the Qiang were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng secretly entrusted the generals with his strategy. Nu Erjie was captured and brought back, all his followers were taken prisoner, and the Qiang were pacified.

sentences.zh: 進敷文閣學士，尋詔赴行在。

translations.literal: He was promoted to academician of the Hall for Spreading Letters and soon ordered to proceed to the temporary capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to academician of the Hall for Spreading Letters and soon ordered to proceed to the temporary capital.

sentences.zh: 正在蜀以簡素化民，歸裝僅書數簏，人服其清。

translations.literal: While in Shu, Zheng transformed the people through simplicity and frugality; his returning baggage held only a few boxes of books, and men admired his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: While in Shu, Zheng transformed the people through simplicity and frugality. His returning baggage held only a few boxes of books, and men admired his integrity.

sentences.zh: 除端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事，參知政事，同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was appointed academician of the Hall of Duanming, concurrently signing clerk at the Bureau of Military Affairs, vice councilor, and associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed academician of the Hall of Duanming, concurrently signing clerk at the Bureau of Military Affairs, vice councilor, and associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 孝宗密諭內禪意，拜右丞相。

translations.literal: Xiaozong secretly informed him of the plan for inner abdication, and he was appointed right grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong secretly informed him of the plan for inner abdication, and he was appointed right grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 一日奏事，皇太子參決侍立，上顧謂太子曰：「留正純誠可託。」

translations.literal: One day while reporting on affairs, the crown prince stood in attendance to participate in decisions. The emperor turned and said to the prince: "Liu Zheng is pure and sincere and can be entrusted."
translations.idiomatic: One day while reporting on affairs, the crown prince stood in attendance to participate in decisions. The emperor turned and said to the prince, "Liu Zheng is pure and sincere and can be entrusted."

sentences.zh: 光宗受禪，主管左右春坊姜特立隨龍恩擢知閤門事，聲勢浸盛。

translations.literal: When Guangzong received the abdication, Jiang TeLi, supervisor of the left and right Eastern Palaces, was promoted on favor from the dragon's ascent to director of the Gatehouse, and his power and influence gradually grew.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong received the abdication, Jiang TeLi, supervisor of the left and right Eastern Palaces, was promoted on favor from the dragon's ascent to director of the Gatehouse, and his power and influence gradually grew.

sentences.zh: 正列其招權預政狀，乞斥逐，上意猶未決。

translations.literal: Zheng set forth his acts of usurping power and interfering in government and begged that he be expelled; the emperor's mind was still undecided.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng set forth his acts of usurping power and interfering in government and begged that he be expelled, but the emperor's mind was still undecided.

sentences.zh: 會副參闕，特立謁正曰：「上以丞相在位久，欲遷左相，葉翥、張枃當擇一人執政，未知孰先？

translations.literal: When the vice councilor's post fell vacant, TeLi called on Zheng and said: "The emperor, because the grand councilor has long been in office, wishes to transfer him to left grand councilor. Ye Yu and Zhang Yan — one must be chosen to govern; it is not yet known which comes first."
translations.idiomatic: When the vice councilor's post fell vacant, TeLi called on Zheng and said, "The emperor, because the grand councilor has long been in office, wishes to transfer him to left grand councilor. Ye Yu and Zhang Yan — one must be chosen to govern, and it is not yet known which comes first."

sentences.zh: 」正奏之，上大怒，詔特立提舉興國宮。

translations.literal: " Zheng reported this; the emperor was greatly angered and ordered TeLi made director of the Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: " Zheng reported this. The emperor was greatly angered and ordered TeLi made director of the Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 孝宗聞之，曰：「真宰相也。」

translations.literal: When Xiaozong heard of it he said: "A true grand councilor."
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong heard of it he said, "A true grand councilor."

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年，進左丞相。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxi he was promoted to left grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1190 he was promoted to left grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 正謹法度，惜名器，豪髮不可干以私。

translations.literal: Zheng was strict in law and precedent, cherished official titles, and not even a hair's breadth could be touched by private interest.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was strict in law and precedent, cherished official titles, and not even a hair's breadth could be touched by private interest.

sentences.zh: 引趙汝愚首從班，卒與之共政。

translations.literal: He brought Zhao Ruyu forward from the head of the attendant corps and in the end governed with him.
translations.idiomatic: He brought Zhao Ruyu forward from the head of the attendant corps and in the end governed with him.

sentences.zh: 用黃裳為皇子嘉王翊善，世號得人。

translations.literal: He employed Huang Shang as tutor to Prince Jia and his generation hailed it as a choice of the right man.
translations.idiomatic: He employed Huang Shang as tutor to Prince Jia, and his generation hailed it as a choice of the right man.

sentences.zh: 嘉王感疾，正言：「陛下只有一子，隔在宮牆外非便，乃令蚤正元良之位，入居東宮，則朝夕相見甚順。

translations.literal: When Prince Jia fell ill, Zheng said: "Your Majesty has only one son. Keeping him beyond the palace walls is inconvenient. Let him early be confirmed in the position of heir apparent and move into the Eastern Palace — then father and son may meet morning and evening, which is very fitting."
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Jia fell ill, Zheng said, "Your Majesty has only one son. Keeping him beyond the palace walls is inconvenient. Let him be confirmed early in the position of heir apparent and move into the Eastern Palace — then father and son may meet morning and evening, which is very fitting."

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「太子，天下本。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The crown prince is the root of the realm."
translations.idiomatic: " He also memorialized, "The crown prince is the root of the realm."

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：『豫建太子，所以重宗廟社稷』。

translations.literal: The Classic of Documents says: "Establishing the crown prince in advance is how one honors the ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain."
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of Documents says, "Establishing the crown prince in advance is how one honors the ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain."

sentences.zh: 漢文帝即位，即建太子。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Han took the throne he at once established the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Han took the throne he at once established the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 本朝皇子居塚嫡，有未出閣而正儲位者。

translations.literal: In our dynasty princes who are the eldest son of the consort's line have, without yet leaving the palace, had the heir's position confirmed.
translations.idiomatic: In our dynasty princes who are the eldest son of the consort's line have, without yet leaving the palace, had the heir's position confirmed.

sentences.zh: 皇子嘉王既居塚嫡，出閤已久，宜早正儲位，以定天下本。

translations.literal: Prince Jia, being the eldest legitimate son, has left the palace long ago; the heir's position should early be confirmed to fix the root of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jia, being the eldest legitimate son, has left the palace long ago. The heir's position should be confirmed early to fix the root of the realm.

sentences.zh: 」再月不報。

translations.literal: " For two months no reply came.
translations.idiomatic: " For two months no reply came.

sentences.zh: 檢《漢·文帝紀》及本朝真宗立仁宗典故，並呂誨、張方平兩奏，節其要語繳奏。

translations.literal: He examined the Annals of Emperor Wen in the History of Han and precedents from our dynasty of Zhenzong establishing Renzong, as well as the two memorials of Lü Hui and Zhang Fangping, excerpted their essential passages, and submitted them for review.
