translations.idiomatic: He examined the Annals of Emperor Wen in the History of Han and precedents from our dynasty of Zhenzong establishing Renzong, as well as the two memorials of Lü Hui and Zhang Fangping, excerpted their essential passages, and submitted them for review.

sentences.zh: 上不豫，外議洶洶，正與同列間至福寧殿奏事，處分得宜，人情以安。

translations.literal: When the emperor was unwell, outside opinion ran turbulent. Zheng and his colleagues went from time to time to the Hall of Blessing and Tranquility to report on affairs; his handling was appropriate and public sentiment was calmed.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was unwell, outside opinion ran turbulent. Zheng and his colleagues went from time to time to the Hall of Blessing and Tranquility to report on affairs. His handling was appropriate and public sentiment was calmed.

sentences.zh: 進封申國公。

translations.literal: He was advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Shen.

sentences.zh: 上疾浸平，正乞歸政，不許。

translations.literal: As the emperor's illness gradually eased, Zheng begged to return power; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: As the emperor's illness gradually eased, Zheng begged to return power, but this was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 初，正帥蜀，慮吳氏世將，謀去之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zheng commanded Shu, he feared the Wu family's hereditary generals and plotted to remove them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zheng commanded Shu, he feared the Wu family's hereditary generals and plotted to remove them.

sentences.zh: 至是，朝廷議更蜀帥，正言：「西邊三將，惟吳氏世襲兵柄，號為『吳家軍』，不知有朝廷。

translations.literal: At this time the court debated replacing the commander in Shu. Zheng said: "Of the three commanders on the western frontier, only the Wu family has inherited military power for generations; they are called the 'Wu Family Army' and do not know there is a court."
translations.idiomatic: At this time the court debated replacing the commander in Shu. Zheng said, "Of the three commanders on the western frontier, only the Wu family has inherited military power for generations. They are called the 'Wu Family Army' and do not know there is a court."

sentences.zh: 」遂以戶部侍郎丘崈行。

translations.literal: " Accordingly Qiu Jun, vice minister of Revenue, was dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: " Accordingly Qiu Jun, vice minister of Revenue, was dispatched.

sentences.zh: 及吳挺死，韓侂胄為吳氏地，使吳曦世襲。

translations.literal: When Wu Ting died, Han Tuozhou made room for the Wu family and had Wu Xi succeed by inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Ting died, Han Tuozhou made room for the Wu family and had Wu Xi succeed by inheritance.

sentences.zh: 正力請留曦環衛，遣張詔代挺。

translations.literal: Zheng strongly petitioned to keep Xi in the palace guard and send Zhang Zhao to replace Ting.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng strongly petitioned to keep Xi in the palace guard and send Zhang Zhao to replace Ting.

sentences.zh: 後數歲，曦入蜀，卒稔變。

translations.literal: Several years later Xi entered Shu and in the end brought rebellion to ripeness.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later Xi entered Shu and in the end brought rebellion to ripeness.

sentences.zh: 壽皇聖政成，進少保，封衛國公。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Governance of the Longevous Emperor was completed, he was promoted to Junior Mentor and enfeoffed Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sacred Governance of the Longevous Emperor was completed, he was promoted to Junior Mentor and enfeoffed Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 李端友以椒房親，手詔除郎，正繳還，上不納，復執奏曰：「昔館陶公主為子求郎，明帝不許。

translations.literal: Li Duanyou, by kinship through the empress's family, received a handwritten edict appointing him gentleman; Zheng returned it for review; the emperor did not accept this and Zheng again firmly memorialized: "In old times when the Princess of Guantao sought a gentlemanship for her son, Emperor Ming would not permit it."
translations.idiomatic: Li Duanyou, by kinship through the empress's family, received a handwritten edict appointing him gentleman. Zheng returned it for review, but the emperor did not accept this. Zheng again firmly memorialized, "In old times when the Princess of Guantao sought a gentlemanship for her son, Emperor Ming would not permit it."

sentences.zh: 今端友依憑內援，恐累聖德。

translations.literal: Now Duanyou relies on inner support; I fear this will impair sagely virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Now Duanyou relies on inner support, and I fear this will impair Your Majesty's sagely virtue.

sentences.zh: 」姜特立除浙東副總管，尋召赴行在，正引唐憲宗召吐突承璀事，乞罷相。

translations.literal: " Jiang TeLi was appointed deputy overall commander of eastern Zhe and soon summoned to the temporary capital. Zheng cited Tang Xianzong's summoning of Tu Tu Chenghui and begged to resign the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: " Jiang TeLi was appointed deputy overall commander of eastern Zhe and soon summoned to the temporary capital. Zheng cited Tang Xianzong's summoning of Tu Tu Chenghui and begged to resign the chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 上批：「成命已行，朕無反汗，卿宜自處。

translations.literal: The emperor annotated: "The finalized appointment has already been issued. I cannot retract my word. You should see to your own conduct."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor annotated, "The finalized appointment has already been issued. I cannot retract my word. You should see to your own conduct."

sentences.zh: 」正待罪六和塔，奏言：「陛下近年，不知何人獻把定之說，遂至每事堅執，斷不可回。

translations.literal: " Zheng awaited punishment at the Liuhe Pagoda and memorialized: "Your Majesty in recent years — I know not who offered the doctrine of holding firm — has come to be obstinate in every matter, absolutely unwilling to turn back."
translations.idiomatic: " Zheng awaited punishment at the Liuhe Pagoda and memorialized, "Your Majesty in recent years — I know not who offered the doctrine of holding firm — has come to be obstinate in every matter, absolutely unwilling to turn back."

sentences.zh: 天下至大，機務至煩，事出於是，則人無異詞，可以固執；

translations.literal: The realm is vast and state affairs exceedingly burdensome. When a matter proceeds from what is right, men have no dissent and one may hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: The realm is vast and state affairs exceedingly burdensome. When a matter proceeds from what is right, men have no dissent and one may hold firm.

sentences.zh: 事出於非，則眾論紛起，必須惟是之從。

translations.literal: When a matter proceeds from what is wrong, diverse opinion rises up, and one must follow only what is right.
translations.idiomatic: When a matter proceeds from what is wrong, diverse opinion rises up, and one must follow only what is right.

sentences.zh: 臣恐自此以往，事無是非，陛下壹持把定之說，言路遂塞。

translations.literal: Your servant fears that from this point forward, whether matters are right or wrong, Your Majesty will uniformly hold to the doctrine of holding firm, and the avenue of speech will be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant fears that from this point forward, whether matters are right or wrong, Your Majesty will uniformly hold to the doctrine of holding firm, and the avenue of speech will be blocked.

sentences.zh: 」因繳進前後錫齎及告敕，待罪范村，乞歸田里，不許。

translations.literal: " He therefore returned for review the gifts and appointment edicts received before and after, awaited punishment at Fancun, and begged to return to the fields; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore returned for review the gifts and appointment edicts received before and after, awaited punishment at Fancun, and begged to return to the fields, but this was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 壽聖太后將以冬至上尊號冊寶，以正為禮儀使，攝太傅。

translations.literal: The Longevous Sagely Empress Dowager was to receive honorific title, seal, and regalia at the winter solstice; Zheng was made ritual commissioner and acted as Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: The Longevous Sagely Empress Dowager was to receive honorific title, seal, and regalia at the winter solstice. Zheng was made ritual commissioner and acted as Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 於是上遣左司徐誼諭旨，正復入都堂視事。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor sent Left Division Director Xu Yi to convey the imperial will, and Zheng again entered the Secretariat to attend to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor sent Left Division Director Xu Yi to convey the imperial will, and Zheng again entered the Secretariat to attend to affairs.

sentences.zh: 是行也，待罪凡一百四十日。

translations.literal: On this occasion he awaited punishment for one hundred forty days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On this occasion he awaited punishment for one hundred forty days in all.

sentences.zh: 冊寶禮成，拜少傅，封魯國公，正力辭。

translations.literal: When the ceremony of seal and regalia was completed he was appointed Junior Tutor and enfeoffed Duke of Lu; Zheng strenuously declined.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony of seal and regalia was completed he was appointed Junior Tutor and enfeoffed Duke of Lu. Zheng strenuously declined.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，孝宗疾革，正數請車駕過宮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, when Xiaozong's illness was critical, Zheng repeatedly requested that the imperial carriage visit the retired emperor's palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, when Xiaozong's illness was critical, Zheng repeatedly requested that the imperial carriage visit the retired emperor's palace.

sentences.zh: 一日，上拂衣起，正引裾泣諫，隨至福寧殿門。

translations.literal: One day the emperor brushed his robe and rose; Zheng seized his hem and wept in remonstrance, following him to the gate of the Hall of Blessing and Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: One day the emperor brushed his robe and rose. Zheng seized his hem and wept in remonstrance, following him to the gate of the Hall of Blessing and Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 正退上疏，言極激切。

translations.literal: Zheng withdrew and submitted a memorial; his words were extremely urgent and forceful.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng withdrew and submitted a memorial whose words were extremely urgent and forceful.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，孝宗崩，光宗以疾未能執喪，正率同列屢奏，乞早正嘉王儲位，又擬指揮付學士院降詔。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu of the sixth month Xiaozong died. Guangzong, owing to illness, was unable to observe mourning. Zheng led his colleagues in repeated memorials begging that Prince Jia's heir position be confirmed early, and also drafted instructions to be sent to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies to issue an edict.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu of the sixth month Xiaozong died. Guangzong, owing to illness, was unable to observe mourning. Zheng led his colleagues in repeated memorials begging that Prince Jia's heir position be confirmed early, and also drafted instructions to be sent to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies to issue an edict.

sentences.zh: 尋有手詔：「朕歷事歲久，念欲退閑。

translations.literal: Soon there came a handwritten edict: "I have served in affairs for many years and wish to retire to leisure."
translations.idiomatic: Soon there came a handwritten edict: "I have served in affairs for many years and wish to retire to leisure."

sentences.zh: 」正得之始懼，請對，復不報。

translations.literal: " When Zheng received it he was first fearful; he requested audience but again received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: " When Zheng received it he was first fearful. He requested audience but again received no reply.

sentences.zh: 即出國門，上表請老，末曰：「願陛下速回淵鑒，追悟前非，漸收人心，庶保國祚。」

translations.literal: He at once left the capital gate and submitted a memorial requesting retirement; at the end he said: "I wish Your Majesty would quickly turn back deep insight, reflect and correct former errors, gradually recover people's hearts, and thereby perhaps preserve the dynasty's mandate."
translations.idiomatic: He at once left the capital gate and submitted a memorial requesting retirement. At the end he said, "I wish Your Majesty would quickly turn back your deep insight, reflect on and correct former errors, gradually recover people's hearts, and thereby perhaps preserve the dynasty's mandate."

sentences.zh: 正始議以上疾未克主喪，宜立皇太子監國；

translations.literal: Zheng had originally proposed that because the emperor's illness prevented him from presiding over mourning, the crown prince should be established to supervise the state.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng had originally proposed that because the emperor's illness prevented him from presiding over mourning, the crown prince should be established to supervise the state.

sentences.zh: 若終喪未倦勤，當復辟。

translations.literal: If when mourning ended he had not grown weary of toil, he should be restored to rule.
translations.idiomatic: If when mourning ended he had not grown weary of toil, he should be restored to rule.

sentences.zh: 設議內禪，太子可即位。

translations.literal: If inner abdication were debated, the crown prince could ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: If inner abdication were debated, the crown prince could ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 時從臣鄭湜奏與正同。

translations.literal: At the time attendant minister Zheng Ni memorialized in agreement with Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: At the time attendant minister Zheng Ni memorialized in agreement with Zheng.

sentences.zh: 既而趙汝愚以內禪請於憲聖，正謂：「建儲詔未下，遽及此，他日必難處。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Zhao Ruyu requested inner abdication from Empress Dowager Xiansheng. Zheng said: "The edict establishing the heir has not yet been issued; to rush to this now will surely be hard to manage hereafter."
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Zhao Ruyu requested inner abdication from Empress Dowager Xiansheng. Zheng said, "The edict establishing the heir has not yet been issued. To rush to this now will surely be hard to manage hereafter."

sentences.zh: 」論既違，以肩輿逃去。

translations.literal: " Once the discussion went against him, he fled in a sedan chair.
translations.idiomatic: " Once the discussion went against him, he fled in a sedan chair.

sentences.zh: 及嘉王即位，尊皇帝為太上皇帝，以正為大行攢宮總護使，寧宗即位。

translations.literal: When Prince Jia ascended the throne the emperor was honored as retired emperor; Zheng was made overall director of the funeral palace for the late emperor; Ningzong ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Jia ascended the throne the emperor was honored as retired emperor, Zheng was made overall director of the funeral palace for the late emperor, and Ningzong ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 入謝，復出。

translations.literal: He entered to give thanks and then went out again.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to give thanks and then went out again.

sentences.zh: 憲聖命速宣押，時汝愚亦以為請，上親劄，遣使召正還。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Xiansheng ordered that he be quickly announced and escorted; at the time Ruyu also petitioned for this; the emperor personally wrote a note and sent an envoy to summon Zheng back.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Xiansheng ordered that he be quickly announced and escorted. At the time Ruyu also petitioned for this. The emperor personally wrote a note and sent an envoy to summon Zheng back.

sentences.zh: 侍御史張叔椿請議正棄國之罰，乃徙叔椿吏部侍郎，而正復相。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Zhang Shuchun requested discussion of punishment for Zheng's abandoning the state; Shuchun was then transferred to vice minister of Personnel, and Zheng again became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Zhang Shuchun requested discussion of punishment for Zheng's abandoning the state. Shuchun was then transferred to vice minister of Personnel, and Zheng again became chancellor.

sentences.zh: 入賀，且請車駕一出，慰安都人心；

translations.literal: He entered to offer congratulations and also requested that the imperial carriage go out once to comfort the hearts of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to offer congratulations and also requested that the imperial carriage go out once to comfort the hearts of the capital.

sentences.zh: 及定壽康宮南向，撤去新增禁旅。

translations.literal: He also fixed the Shoukang Palace facing south and removed the newly added palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: He also fixed the Shoukang Palace facing south and removed the newly added palace guard.

sentences.zh: 詔悉從之。

translations.literal: An edict fully assented to all of this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fully assented to all of this.

sentences.zh: 進少傅，屢辭不拜，奏言：「陛下勉徇群情，以登大寶，當遇事從簡，示天下以不得已之意，實非頒爵之時。」

translations.literal: He was promoted to Junior Tutor and repeatedly declined without accepting investiture, memorializing: "Your Majesty has strained to accord with public sentiment in ascending the great seat. Affairs should be handled with simplicity to show the realm the sense of having no choice — this is truly not the time to distribute ranks."
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Junior Tutor and repeatedly declined without accepting investiture, memorializing, "Your Majesty has strained to accord with public sentiment in ascending the great seat. Affairs should be handled with simplicity to show the realm the sense of having no choice — this is truly not the time to distribute ranks."

sentences.zh: 韓侂胄浸謀預政，數詣都堂，正使省吏諭之曰：「此非知閣日往來之地。

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou gradually plotted to interfere in government and repeatedly visited the Secretariat. Zheng had a secretariat clerk instruct him: "This is not the place the director of the Gatehouse visits day after day."
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou gradually plotted to interfere in government and repeatedly visited the Secretariat. Zheng had a secretariat clerk instruct him, "This is not the place the director of the Gatehouse visits day after day."

sentences.zh: 」侂胄怒而退。

translations.literal: " Tuozhou angrily withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " Tuozhou angrily withdrew.

sentences.zh: 會經筵晚講賜坐，正執奏以為非，上不懌。

translations.literal: When at the evening classics lecture a seat was granted, Zheng firmly memorialized that this was improper; the emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When at the evening classics lecture a seat was granted, Zheng firmly memorialized that this was improper, and the emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 侍御史黃度論馬大同罪，正擬度補外，上知其情，除度右正言。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Huang Du discussed Ma Datong's crime; Zheng planned to assign Du to an outside post, but the emperor knew his intent and appointed Du right rectifier.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Huang Du discussed Ma Datong's crime. Zheng planned to assign Du to an outside post, but the emperor knew his intent and appointed Du right rectifier.

sentences.zh: 正請推恩隨龍人，上曰：「朕未見父母，可恩及下人耶？

translations.literal: Zheng requested extending favor to those who followed the dragon's ascent. The emperor said: "I have not yet seen my parents — how can favor extend to subordinates?"
translations.idiomatic: Zheng requested extending favor to those who followed the dragon's ascent. The emperor said, "I have not yet seen my parents — how can favor extend to subordinates?"

sentences.zh: 」積數事失上意，侂胄從而間之。

translations.literal: " Several such matters accumulated and lost the emperor's favor; Tuozhou then took advantage to sow discord.
translations.idiomatic: " Several such matters accumulated and lost the emperor's favor. Tuozhou then took advantage to sow discord.

sentences.zh: 八月，手詔正以少師、觀文殿大學士判建康府。

translations.literal: In the eighth month a handwritten edict made Zheng Junior Preceptor, grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, and assigned him to judge Jiankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month a handwritten edict made Zheng Junior Preceptor, grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, and assigned him to judge Jiankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 尋又以諫議大夫張叔椿言，落職。

translations.literal: Soon, on the word of remonstrance and counsel grandee Zhang Shuchun, his rank was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, on the word of remonstrance and counsel grandee Zhang Shuchun, his rank was stripped.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年六月，詔正以上皇付正手詔八字進入，宣付史館。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Qingyuan an edict ordered that the eight characters of the retired emperor's handwritten edict delivered to Zheng be entered and announced to the History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1195 an edict ordered that the eight characters of the retired emperor's handwritten edict delivered to Zheng be entered and announced to the History Institute.

sentences.zh: 復觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: He was restored as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature.

sentences.zh: 初，劉德秀自重慶入朝，未為正所知，謁正客范仲黼請為言，正曰：「此人若留之班行，朝廷必不靜。

translations.literal: Earlier, Liu Dexiu entered court from Chongqing and was not yet known to Zheng. He called on Zheng's guest Fan Zhongfu and asked him to speak on his behalf. Zheng said: "If this man is kept in the court corps, the court will surely not be quiet."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Liu Dexiu entered court from Chongqing and was not yet known to Zheng. He called on Zheng's guest Fan Zhongfu and asked him to speak on his behalf. Zheng said, "If this man is kept in the court corps, the court will surely not be quiet."

sentences.zh: 」乃除大理簿，德秀憾之。

translations.literal: " He was therefore appointed recorder in the Court of Judicial Review; Dexiu resented this.
translations.idiomatic: " He was therefore appointed recorder in the Court of Judicial Review. Dexiu resented this.

sentences.zh: 至是為諫議大夫，論正四大罪，褫職，自是彈劾無虛歲。

translations.literal: At this time, as remonstrance and counsel grandee, he charged Zheng with four great crimes; Zheng was stripped of rank, and from this point impeachment came every year without fail.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, as remonstrance and counsel grandee, he charged Zheng with four great crimes. Zheng was stripped of rank, and from this point impeachment came every year without fail.

sentences.zh: 以張釜言，責授中大夫、光祿卿，分司西京，邵州居住。

translations.literal: On Zhang Fu's word he was demoted and appointed Grand Master of Palace Service and Director of the Imperial Household, with duty at the Western Capital and residence in Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On Zhang Fu's word he was demoted and appointed Grand Master of Palace Service and Director of the Imperial Household, with duty at the Western Capital and residence in Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，令自便。

translations.literal: The next year he was permitted to go where he pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was permitted to go where he pleased.

sentences.zh: 給事中謝源明封還錄黃，量移南劍州，再許自便。

translations.literal: Supervisory Secretariat attendant Xie Yuanming sealed and returned the recorded edict; Zheng was transferred in degree to Nanjian Prefecture and again permitted to go where he pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory Secretariat attendant Xie Yuanming sealed and returned the recorded edict. Zheng was transferred in degree to Nanjian Prefecture and again permitted to go where he pleased.

sentences.zh: 復光祿大夫、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: He was restored as Grand Master of the Imperial Household and made director of the Tongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as Grand Master of the Imperial Household and made director of the Tongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 上章乞納祿，詔復元官職致仕。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial begging to surrender his stipend; an edict restored his original office and rank and granted retirement.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial begging to surrender his stipend. An edict restored his original office and rank and granted retirement.

sentences.zh: 又以御史林采言，依舊官光祿大夫致仕。

translations.literal: Again, on supervising censor Lin Cai's word, he retired with his former rank as Grand Master of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Again, on supervising censor Lin Cai's word, he retired with his former rank as Grand Master of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 俄復觀文殿學士、金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he was again made academician of the Observing Culture Hall and grand master of golden glory and purple light.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again made academician of the Observing Culture Hall and grand master of golden glory and purple light.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年，進封魏國公，復少師、觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiatai he was advanced to Duke of Wei and again made junior mentor and grand academician of the Observing Culture Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In 1201 he was advanced to Duke of Wei and again made junior mentor and grand academician of the Observing Culture Hall.

sentences.zh: 開禧二年七月，薨，年七十八。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Kaixi he died, aged seventy-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1206 he died at the age of seventy-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈太師。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 正出處大致如紹熙去國，恥與姜特立並位而待罪近郊，五月復入，議者猶惜其去之不勇。

translations.literal: Zheng's coming forth and withdrawal broadly resembled his departure from court in Shaoxi: he was ashamed to hold office alongside Jiang TeLi and awaited punishment in the suburbs, then re-entered in the fifth month — yet critics still regretted that his withdrawal had not been bold enough.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's career moves broadly resembled his departure from court in the Shaoxi era: ashamed to hold office alongside Jiang TeLi, he awaited punishment in the suburbs, then returned in the fifth month, yet critics still regretted that he had not withdrawn more boldly.

sentences.zh: 首發大議，蚤正嘉王儲位，遂致言者深文，指為棄國，豈弘毅有所不足耶？

translations.literal: He was first to raise great debate and early to establish Prince Jia as heir apparent, thereby drawing remonstrators to elaborate charges and call it abandoning the state — was there some lack in firm resolve?
translations.idiomatic: He was first to raise great debate and early to establish Prince Jia as heir apparent, drawing remonstrators to elaborate charges and accuse him of abandoning the state. Was there truly some lack in firm resolve?

sentences.zh: 或問范仲黼：「留、趙二公處變不同如何？

translations.literal: Someone asked Fan Zhongfu: "How do the two lords Liu and Zhao differ in handling change?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone asked Fan Zhongfu, "How did Lords Liu and Zhao differ in handling crisis?"

sentences.zh: 」仲黼曰：「趙，同姓之卿也；

translations.literal: " Zhongfu said: "Zhao is a minister of the same surname;"
translations.idiomatic: " Zhongfu said, "Zhao is a minister of the imperial surname;"

sentences.zh: 留則異姓之卿，反復之而不聽，則去。

translations.literal: "Liu is a minister of another surname — if he remonstrates repeatedly and is not heeded, he leaves."
translations.idiomatic: "Liu is a minister of another surname. If he remonstrates repeatedly and is not heeded, he leaves."

sentences.zh: 」聞者以為名言。

translations.literal: " Hearers regarded this as a famous saying.
translations.idiomatic: " Hearers regarded this as a famous saying.

sentences.zh: 有詩、文、奏議、外制二十卷行於世。

translations.literal: He had twenty juan of poetry, prose, memorials, and external compositions circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty juan of his poetry, prose, memorials, and external compositions circulated in the world.

sentences.zh: 寶慶三年，諡「忠宣」。

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoqing he was given the posthumous title "Loyal and Proclaiming."
translations.idiomatic: In 1227 he was given the posthumous title Loyal and Proclaiming.

sentences.zh: 子：恭、丙、端，皆為尚書郎。

translations.literal: Sons: Gong, Bing, and Duan — all were secretaries in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Gong, Bing, and Duan all served as secretaries in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 孫：元英，工部侍郎；

translations.literal: Grandsons: Yuanying, vice minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: His grandsons included Yuanying, vice minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 元剛，起居舍人。

translations.literal: and Yuangang, attendant of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: and Yuangang, attendant of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 胡晉臣

translations.literal: Hu Jinchen
translations.idiomatic: Hu Jinchen

sentences.zh: 胡晉臣，字子遠，蜀州人。

translations.literal: Hu Jinchen, courtesy name Ziyuan, was a man of Shu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Jinchen, whose courtesy name was Ziyuan, was a native of Shu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 登紹興二十七年進士第，為成都通判。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Shaoxing he passed the jinshi examination and was made transit judge of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1157 he passed the jinshi examination and was made transit judge of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 制置使范成大以公輔薦諸朝，孝宗召赴行在。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Fan Chengda recommended him to the court as material for chief minister; Xiaozong summoned him to the temporary capital.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Fan Chengda recommended him to the court as chief-minister material, and Xiaozong summoned him to the temporary capital.

sentences.zh: 入對，疏當今士俗、民力、邊備、軍政四弊。

translations.literal: On audience he memorialized the four abuses of the age: scholar-official custom, popular strength, frontier preparedness, and military government.
translations.idiomatic: At audience he memorialized the four abuses of the age: scholar-official custom, popular strength, frontier preparedness, and military government.

sentences.zh: 試學士院，除秘書省校書郎，遷著作佐郎兼右曹郎官。

translations.literal: He passed the Hanlin examination, was appointed collator of the Secretariat, and was transferred to assistant compiler and concurrently reviewer in the right bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the Hanlin examination, was appointed collator of the Secretariat, and was transferred to assistant compiler while concurrently serving as reviewer in the right bureau.

sentences.zh: 輪對，論三事：一，無忽講讀官，以仁宗為法；

translations.literal: In rotation audience he discussed three matters: first, do not neglect lecture and reading officials, taking Renzong as model;
translations.idiomatic: In rotation audience he discussed three matters: first, do not neglect lecture and reading officials, taking Emperor Renzong as the model;

sentences.zh: 二，責諫官以糾官邪，責宰相以抑奔競；

translations.literal: second, charge remonstrance officials to correct official wickedness and charge the chancellor to restrain frantic competition;
translations.idiomatic: second, charge remonstrance officials to correct official wickedness and charge the chancellor to restrain frantic competition for office;

sentences.zh: 三，廣聽納、通下情，以銷未形之患。

translations.literal: third, broaden listening and acceptance and connect with sentiment below, to dissolve troubles not yet formed.
translations.idiomatic: third, broaden listening and acceptance and connect with sentiment below, to dissolve troubles before they take shape.

sentences.zh: 又極論近倖，上覽奏色動。

translations.literal: He also argued at length against recent favorites; the emperor, reading the memorial, changed expression.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued at length against recent favorites. Reading the memorial, the emperor's expression changed.

sentences.zh: 晉臣口陳甚悉，至論及兩稅折變，天威稍霽，首肯久之。

translations.literal: Jinchen stated orally in great detail; when the discussion reached conversion of the two-tax levy, imperial severity eased somewhat and he nodded assent for a long while.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchen stated his case orally in great detail. When the discussion reached conversion of the two-tax levy, imperial severity eased somewhat and the emperor nodded assent for a long while.

sentences.zh: 趙雄時秉政，手詔下中書問近倖姓名。

translations.literal: Zhao Xiong then held power; a handwritten edict was sent to the Secretariat asking the names of recent favorites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiong then held power. A handwritten edict was sent to the Secretariat asking the names of recent favorites.

sentences.zh: 晉臣翼日至中書，執政詰其故，晉臣曰：「近習招權，丞相豈不知之？

translations.literal: The next day Jinchen went to the Secretariat; the chief minister questioned the reason; Jinchen said: "Recent intimates usurp power — how could the chief minister not know?"
translations.idiomatic: The next day Jinchen went to the Secretariat. The chief minister questioned him. Jinchen said, "Recent intimates usurp power. How could the chief minister not know?"

sentences.zh: 」即條具大者以聞。

translations.literal: " He immediately listed the major cases and reported them.
translations.idiomatic: " He immediately listed the major cases and reported them.

sentences.zh: 上感悟，自是近習嚴憚。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved to understanding; from this time recent intimates were deeply restrained.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved to understanding, and from that time recent intimates were deeply restrained.

sentences.zh: 晉臣以親年高，求外補，知漢州，除潼川路提點刑獄，以憂去。

translations.literal: Jinchen, because his parents were advanced in years, sought an outside post, knew Han Prefecture, was appointed judicial intendant of Tongchuan circuit, and left on mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Because his parents were advanced in years, Jinchen sought an outside post, served as prefect of Han, was appointed judicial intendant of Tongchuan circuit, and left on mourning.

sentences.zh: 服除再召，以五事見，曰：選將帥，廣常平，治渠堰，更銓法，通楮幣。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was summoned again and presented five items: select generals and commanders, expand the Ever-Normal Granaries, repair canals and dikes, reform the evaluation law, and circulate paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was summoned again and presented five proposals: select generals and commanders, expand the Ever-Normal Granaries, repair canals and dikes, reform the evaluation law, and circulate paper currency.

sentences.zh: 上謂輔臣曰：「胡晉臣言可行。」

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "What Hu Jinchen says can be carried out."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers, "What Hu Jinchen says can be carried out."

sentences.zh: 除度支郎，累遷侍御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed reviewer in the Ministry of Revenue and was promoted through attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed reviewer in the Ministry of Revenue and was promoted to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 朱熹除兵部郎官，以病足未供職。

translations.literal: Zhu Xi was appointed secretary in the Ministry of War but, because of illness in his feet, had not yet taken office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi was appointed secretary in the Ministry of War but, because of illness in his feet, had not yet taken office.

sentences.zh: 侍郎林栗與熹論《易》不合，因奏熹不即受印為傲慢。

translations.literal: Vice minister Lin Li disagreed with Xi in discussing the Changes and therefore memorialized that Xi's failure to accept the seal at once was arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: Vice minister Lin Li disagreed with Xi in discussing the Changes and therefore memorialized that Xi's failure to accept the seal at once was arrogance.

sentences.zh: 晉臣上疏留熹而排栗，物論歸重。

translations.literal: Jinchen memorialized to retain Xi and reject Li; public opinion turned weight to him.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchen memorialized to retain Xi and reject Li, and public opinion turned in his favor.

sentences.zh: 光宗嗣位，遷工部侍郎，除給事中，每以裁濫恩、惜名器為重，內降持不下，上嘉其有守，拜端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: When Guangzong succeeded the throne, Jinchen was transferred to vice minister of Works and appointed supervisory secretary; he always made cutting excessive favor and cherishing titles his priority, held back inner edicts and would not issue them, and the emperor commended his integrity and appointed him academician of the Bright Hall and signer at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong succeeded the throne, he was transferred to vice minister of Works and appointed supervisory secretary. He always made cutting excessive favor and cherishing titles his priority, held back inner edicts and would not issue them, and the emperor commended his integrity and appointed him academician of the Bright Hall and signer at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正謝日，上命條上軍政利害。

translations.literal: On the day of his thanksgiving audience, the emperor ordered him to list military affairs, benefits and harms.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of his thanksgiving audience, the emperor ordered him to list the benefits and harms of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 既而朝重華宮，孝宗謂曰：「嗣君擢任二三大臣，深愜朕意，聞外庭亦無異詞。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he attended court at the Chonghua Palace; Xiaozong said to him: "The succeeding ruler has elevated two or three great ministers — this deeply satisfies my intent; I hear the outer court also has no dissenting words."
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he attended court at the Chonghua Palace. Xiaozong said to him, "The succeeding ruler has elevated two or three great ministers. This deeply satisfies my intent, and I hear the outer court also has no dissent."

sentences.zh: 」晉臣拜謝。

translations.literal: " Jinchen bowed in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: " Jinchen bowed in thanks.

sentences.zh: 論曰：謀大事，決大議，非凝定有立者不能也。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: To plan great affairs and decide great deliberations — none but one who is settled and established can do it.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: To plan great affairs and decide great deliberations, none but a man who is settled and established can succeed.

sentences.zh: 周必大、留正一時俱以相業稱，然必大純篤忠厚，能以善道其君，光、寧禪受之際，懼禍而去，其可為有立乎哉？

translations.literal: Zhou Bida and Liu Zheng were both famed at one time for chancellorship, yet Bida was pure, sincere, and loyal and could guide his ruler by the good way; at the abdications of Guang and Ning he feared calamity and left — could this be called being established?
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bida and Liu Zheng were both famed at one time for chancellorship. Bida was pure, sincere, and loyal and could guide his ruler by the good way, yet at the abdications of Guangzong and Ningzong he feared calamity and withdrew. Could that be called being established?

sentences.zh: 若胡晉臣爭論朱熹，則侃侃有守者也。

translations.literal: As for Hu Jinchen arguing on behalf of Zhu Xi, he was one who spoke forthrightly and had integrity.
translations.idiomatic: As for Hu Jinchen arguing on behalf of Zhu Xi, he was a man who spoke forthrightly and held firm to his principles.
